name: MANTRA
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the RevertIQ label and description.
rootCause: MANTRA’s OM token fell more than 90% on 2025-04-13. The public record supports a disputed liquidation cascade around ERC-20 OM, but it does not verify the existing $5.5 billion exit-scam claim. Unknown. The available record supports a liquidation cascade in the ERC-20 OM market, with large pre-crash exchange deposits and exchange-side forced closures alleged, but it does not identify the first seller, the wallet owners, or whether the trigger was insider selling, forced liquidations, or both.
